title: Concatenation of guarded reachability and halting
statement: Let $A$ be a register program with oracle, let $x$ be an input, and let $G$ be a predicate on configurations. If a run from configuration $a$ reaches configuration $b$ with $G$ holding at every configuration before reaching $b$, and a run from $b$ halts with answer $r$ while satisfying $G$ at every configuration before halting, then the run from $a$ halts with answer $r$ and satisfies $G$ at every configuration before halting.
